name: FAQ
deprecation_reason: Generic accordion behavior does not require an island and can be authored with accessible native HTML.
usage_hint: Compatibility contract for existing pages. Do not author this retired island in new source.
when_to_use: Inspect an existing page only; use the replacement in workflows/island-selection-workflow.md for new source.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for new page authoring.
anti_patterns: More than 15 items (overwhelming; split into categories or dedicated FAQ page)
Very long answers (200+ words; breaks accordion UX; summarize or link to full article)
Using as a substitute for clear product descriptions (FAQ should supplement, not replace core info)
Generic questions that apply to all products mixed with product-specific ones (separate site-wide FAQ from PDP-specific)
Opening all items by default (defeats accordion purpose; let users expand what they need)
